description: Read-only agent review pipelines — named sets of diagnostic agents that aggregate into one report, consumed by /fe-pre-merge-review and /fe-prod-readiness. Every step references a real agent in agent-os/agents/ and every handoff target a real skill in agent-os/skills/ (both eval-enforced). Each finding is one line in REVIEW.md → Findings format and names the procedural skill that fixes it (agent finds, skill fixes). An agent that two pipelines share (fe-production-hardening-reviewer) runs once per HEAD: a pipeline run after the other on the same HEAD reuses its report.

fe-pre-merge-review.description: Read-only review of the current diff before merge. The steps whose `when` matches the diff run at once, in the background; each returns findings in REVIEW.md → Findings format.

when.fe-docs-auditor: a docs/**, *.md, *.mdc or agent-os/** file changed
when.fe-production-hardening-reviewer: diff mode — auth, tokens, CSP or tenancy changed: src/shared/auth/, src/core/http/, src/shared/tenancy/, src/app/guards/, src/core/config/, src/lib/csp-api-origin.ts, plugins/csp-api-origin.ts, index.html or netlify.toml

fe-pre-merge-review.aggregate: one report in REVIEW.md → Findings format — sorted by severity (critical first), duplicates merged, at most two nits; then the verifier's verdict and evidence

lenses.fe-full-code-review: the code pass, in diff mode, on the same files as fe-production-hardening-reviewer — one general-purpose agent applies the skill's Diff mode to the diff

fe-prod-readiness.description: Production-readiness sweep before a release/deploy — dependencies, bundle, runtime performance, and client-security hardening. fe-dependency-auditor and fe-production-hardening-reviewer run at once in the background; fe-bundle-size-reviewer and then fe-perf-auditor each build the app, so they run one after the other. The hardening reviewer runs once: when /fe-pre-merge-review already ran it on this HEAD, its report is reused.
fe-prod-readiness.aggregate: one report in REVIEW.md → Findings format: satisfied items, then findings by severity (critical and major block the release, minor and nit are the optional improvements)
